_comment: SINDy training specification — place in Library/Training_Specifications/
name: sindy_fluid

_notes.poly_degree: 2 gives O(n²) features (good default). 3 is expensive but may help.
_notes.sindy_threshold: Main knob. Plot coefficient magnitudes first (visualize_Coefficient_Sparsity), then set threshold just above the noise floor.
_notes.sindy_alpha: Ridge regularisation for STLSQ. Increase (1e-4, 1e-3) if Θ is ill-conditioned.
_notes.sindy_nu: SR3 relaxation parameter. Smaller ν → more aggressive sparsity.
_notes.sindy_optimizer: stlsq is faster and usually sufficient. Try sr3 if stlsq is unstable.
_notes.max_samples: Set to e.g. 50000 to cap memory usage when dataset is large.
